I ran 22 author-independent mutations against scratchpad copies (zero repo writes): 20 killed including max_pbo=0.50 -- the exact 2.5x error this step exists to prevent -- plus hash-flip, post-hash ranking edit, 16-char truncation, HTML-comment burial, dead/empty globs, blank and off-vocabulary cells; the one C3 survivor is equivalent (M4b confirms the guard bites at exactly the criterion's floor of 3). CONDITIONAL rests on four evidence-quality findings, none of which falsifies a criterion today: (1) the ordering guard is blind to the repo's canonical backtest-artifact naming -- I executed a backdated artifact named per backend/backtest/result_store.py:36 f"{ts}_{safe_id}.json" and C5 stayed GREEN while the author's hand-named phase-tag shape turns it RED, so the anti-tuning guarantee holds only for a naming convention nothing binds 83.5 to; (2) urls_collected=85 does not reproduce under its own stated rule -- 12 variants swept, the internally consistent rule that yields the pack's own 63 and 16 yields 79, which also collapses the disclosed "16 vs 22" disagreement into agreement at 16; (3) criterion 7's guard silently drops any candidate row lacking a leading ordinal, so an unclassified candidate can hide by omitting its number (numbered version killed); (4) negative-evidence label drift on entries 1-2 (numbers reproduce, labels do not). All four are cheap, append-only-compatible fixes.

violation_details.state: external_sources_read_in_full=87 reproduces EXACTLY (sum of the 8 lenses' sources_read_in_full_count = 16+13+8+7+8+9+16+10). Under the http-only-distinct rule, read_in_full=true distinct URLs = 63 (matches the pack) and read_in_full=false distinct URLs = 16 (matches the pack) -- but unique source_url under that same rule = 79, not 85. No variant produced 85 (all=100, nofrag=96, hard=95, ex_lens8=82, http_only=79, cross-file=79). Consequence: the pack's honesty-ledger line 'an alternative rule -- 85 unique URLs minus 63 distinct full-read URLs -- gives 22' is arithmetic on a wrong input; under the internally consistent rule it is 79-63=16, i.e. the two rules AGREE and the disclosed 16-vs-22 disagreement is an artifact. The same 85 is carried upstream by handoff/current/research_brief_83.1.md section A9.
violation_details.constraint: SEVERITY=WARN. research_brief_phase83.md line 96 states the rule explicitly: 'urls_collected = re-derived unique source_url count'. qa.md 4b: every numeric claim must reproduce under the command that produces it. Criterion 1 constrains only that the key be REPORTED (and asserts >=5 full-reads + recency true, both verified true and both reproducing), so this is not a criterion miss -- but it is a non-reproducing number inside the artifact whose stated value is that every figure carries a reproducible derivation rule. Fix: 85 -> 79 and delete/repair the 22 alternative.

violation_details.action: Appended an unclassified candidate row to the pack's section-4 table WITHOUT a leading ordinal and re-ran test_c7_every_candidate_classified_from_closed_vocabulary; then repeated with the ordinal present.

violation_details.constraint: SEVERITY=WARN. Criterion 7: 'a test asserts the count of candidates with no classification is exactly zero'. The guard kills every natural mutation on conforming rows (blank cell, off-vocabulary token, silently widened vocabulary -- all three executed and killed), and all 7 shipped candidates are numbered and validly classified, so criterion 7 is MET today. But the count is taken over an author-definable population, which is the qa.md 4c shape-2/shape-10 pattern. Fix: match any table row inside section 4 that is not the header/separator, or assert the row count equals a pre-registered candidate count.

violation_details.action: Compared each numbered entry in the pack's section 5 against its corpus source (research.json lens 7 key_findings).
violation_details.state: Entry 1: pack says '-3.1%/yr RAW, -3.24%/yr FFC4-adjusted over the first 5 years post-launch'; kf[1].numbers says 'risk-adjusted return -3.1%/yr AFTER FEES; about -6% annually in the first five years after inception; FFC4 alpha -3.24%/yr vs -0.24%/yr'.
